Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit, before any margin (cost:350020).
To support the volume and contract length we propose:
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €427.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We acknowledge your counter-offer and the data provided.
While our base prices are currently fixed until December 2027, we can offer a revised price of EUR 427.48 per unit by incorporating your proposed 14-day payment terms and 24-month contract duration.
Our colleagues will address your inquiry regarding the cost breakdown separately.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
